description: This file contains unit tests for generic Orleans grains using Azure storage providers (Table Storage and Blob Storage). It includes test fixtures configuring test clusters with specific storage options and test methods verifying grain behaviors with long and short grain names.

classes.name: GenericGrainsInAzureTableStorageTests
classes.description: Test class for grains stored in Azure Table Storage, includes fixture setup.

classes.name: GenericGrainsInAzureBlobStorageTests
classes.description: Test class for grains stored in Azure Blob Storage, includes fixture setup.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture configuring the Orleans test cluster for Azure storage, for Table and Blob storage respectively.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with storage-specific silo configurators.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Verifies preconditions for the test, ensuring emulator is not used.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureTableStorage_LongNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method verifying echo functionality for a long-named grain stored in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureTableStorage_ShortNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method verifying echo functionality for a short-named grain stored in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureBlobStorage_LongNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method verifying echo functionality for a long-named grain stored in Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: Generic_OnAzureBlobStorage_ShortNamedGrain_EchoValue
methods.description: Test method verifying echo functionality for a short-named grain stored in Azure Blob Storage.
